damage_basis: ICNF official annual report: direct forest-sector losses (timber/shrubland); same ICNF basis as the annual fire statistics series. Broader estimates (Ministry: ~EUR 1bn; social-cost studies: EUR 1.3bn) are wider-definition. In 2025 prices: EUR 611M x 1.526 (HICP) = ~EUR 932M. The PRD's '>EUR 800M' is consistent with the 2025-price figure but not the 2003 nominal.
area_basis: ICNF official annual report (same source as area_ha: 425,839 ha = 286,055 ha forest + 139,784 ha shrubland)
verification: area confirmed (matches ICNF annual report and Wikipedia); damage EUR 611M is the primary ICNF direct-loss figure in 2003 prices, sourced via ECO Sapo article citing ICNF data and confirmed by a second search. Broader government estimates (~EUR 925M-1bn) include wider economic impacts. Outside the EFFIS per-fire window so cannot be used for per-fire fitting, only as annual-total cross-check.

damage_basis: Forest-sector loss only (timber/resin/cork, stored carbon, biomass, fruits); excludes homes and infrastructure
verification: a component of loss, so a floor and not a total; no published total economic loss for 2024 was found
